page.overview:
Who is Cloud Dance?

Cloud Dance is a Fat Villager who appears in the "Stakes" miniseries. He is part of the attempt to kill Marceline after she is accused of sucking the blood from the cows of the village. He soon realizes his mistake, though, as Marceline is about to be killed.
